title: Graph analysis, value table and Graphs tab UI

features.notes: Parse f and g with the evaluator's grammar and safety checks (P23/P27/P28), not raw sympify. Use the existing 12-digit formatter. Find roots and extrema numerically in [lower, upper] and snap to exact values. No zero or intersection: 200 with domain_error. Bad operation, missing parameter or lower >= upper: 400.
Reuse P10's sampling and f1-f4 validation. Give x as decimal strings ("0.5"). A non-real value is null. Step 0, rows < 1 or rows > 1000 answer 400.
Plain JS, no external resources. Draw the API's series on graph-canvas with gaps where y is null. Keep long-text wrapping (P33). Leave the Calculator tab's ids and behaviour unchanged.
